goal: Create a calm photorealistic floor-seated editorial portrait of one fictional adult woman with complete anatomy, natural material detail, and restrained indoor atmosphere.
audience: Editorial art directors seeking an adult, non-promotional, realistic character portrait with quiet composition and credible textile detail

content.subject: One fictional 29-year-old woman seated naturally on a pale gray studio floor against a lightly textured mineral-plaster wall
must_include: Exactly one clearly adult fictional woman
Complete crown, face, shoulders, torso, both knees, and both hands with coherent anatomy
Natural softly tousled chin-length dark hair, warm brown eyes, minimal makeup, natural pores, and faint under-eye texture
Unbranded charcoal rib-knit crew top under a softened dove-gray cotton shirt with charcoal relaxed trousers
One open hand with distinct fingers resting beside her thigh and one hand gathering a loose shirt cuff
Pale gray floor and textured mineral-plaster wall with quiet upper-left negative space and soft camera-left light
must_avoid: Childlike appearance, exposed midriff, cleavage, lingerie, sheer clothing, sensual posing, or glamour treatment
Brand, logo, text, watermark, signature, jewelry, sunglasses, phone, furniture, or external reference
Extra people, duplicate features, malformed anatomy, cropped head, hands, or knees
Beauty smoothing, plastic skin, heavy haze, illustration, cartoon, anime, CGI, collage, or copied campaign aesthetic

art_direction.lighting: Broad soft camera-left window-like key, subtle ambient fill, gentle gradual shadow falloff, restrained highlight bloom

composition.layout: Vertical floor-seated portrait, subject slightly right of center with calm upper-left negative space
focal_hierarchy: Calm adult face and directable gaze
Coherent hands, knees, and relaxed seated posture
Layered shirt, knit, and trouser materials

objective_checks: Output is exactly 941x1672 PNG/RGB without alpha
No visible text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Crown, face, shoulders, torso, hands, knees, and seated posture are coherent
Skin, hair, knit, cotton, and wall materials remain photographic without beauty smoothing
Wardrobe remains modest, unbranded, and non-sexualized
The image is distinct from a studio close-up, outdoor documentary, motion, rehearsal, craft, fashion-grid, and character-sheet image
